title: VTC Join-Requests — Withdraw — payload
description: What an applicant sends to close their own open join request. Every member is optional: the authenticated issuer identifies the applicant, and a community that allows at most one open request per applicant can resolve the request from that alone. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

requestId.description: The request to withdraw. Optional: an applicant whose submit response was lost never received an id, and the id-less form — resolved from the authenticated applicant's own identifier — is the only one available to them. Supply it when you have it; a consumer that has it MUST prefer it over inferring the request from the caller.

reason.description: Free text for the humans who will read the community's record of this withdrawal — a vetter who attested, or a maintainer mid-review. A consumer MUST NOT interpret it or branch on its content. A producer MUST NOT put credentials, secrets, or personal data about anyone other than the applicant into it.

Response.title: VTC Join-Requests — Withdraw — response payload
Response.description: Confirms which request was closed. Failures use trust-task-error, not this shape.

requestId.description: The request that was withdrawn. Returned even when the request omitted it, so an applicant who used the id-less form learns which request they closed.

status.description: The request's state after the withdrawal. Always `withdrawn`; returned rather than implied so the response is self-describing to a reader holding only this document.
